purpose: Determine conceptual independence of the exact Campaign040 high/low distribution mechanism before implementing it or reading any protected value.

candidate.name: intraday_morning_afternoon_range_profile_similarity_120b
candidate.formula: For j=0..119, let x_j=log(morning_high_j/morning_low_j) and y_j=log(afternoon_high_j/afternoon_low_j). Let X=sum(x), Y=sum(y), p_j=x_j/X, q_j=y_j/Y, and m_j=(p_j+q_j)/2. Let JSD=0.5*sum_{p_j>0}(p_j*log(p_j/m_j))+0.5*sum_{q_j>0}(q_j*log(q_j/m_j)), using 0*log(0)=0. Return 1-JSD/log(2).

mechanism_family_review.reason: Campaign018 correlates range magnitude with share volume and earlier amount-volatility factors use activity. Campaign040 reads no activity and compares two normalized clock-time range distributions.

Campaign023 uses adjacent high/low boundary changes, Campaign025 uses first global extreme order, Campaign036 uses new frontier expansions, and range-reversal families use boundary revisit. Campaign040 uses only per-bar high/low width mass after separate half-session normalization.
Campaign027 uses population Pearson correlation of signed close-return vectors. Campaign040 uses Jensen-Shannon similarity of nonnegative high/low range probability distributions and no close.

Campaign040 does not compute a pooled entropy or count zero ranges. Jensen-Shannon divergence compares two separately normalized half-session profiles; exact zero ranges remain fixed support and all statistical comparisons remain mandatory.
Campaign040 reads no close, forms no return, frequency power, cubic contrast, chord, trend, or path travel.
Candidate49 uses causal cumulative amount/volume VWAP crossings and is future-only. Campaign040 reads no close, amount, volume, crossing, or anchor.
Campaign040 contains one raw high/low statistic and no prior factor value, learned weight, filter, transform, model, or combination.
